summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of 75 million depositary shares representing 7.00% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock. Concurrently, it offers 45.5M common shares and an ATM program for up to $1.25B. Proceeds fund component purchases for ~$39B in AI server orders. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. The filing does not involve a change of control, strategic review, or activist campaign. It is a routine equity offering under existing shelf registration.
